title: Classic Swing Animation
description: A mod that returns the classic, pre 1.9, swing animation back into Minecraft.
body:
# Classic Swing Animation

*Classic Swing Animation* is a small Fabric mod that reverts the swinging animation back to how it was in 1.8 or before.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/TlroWr54Khk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Installation
* Download the latest build of Classic Swing Animation.
* Place the JAR file in your mod folder.
* Ensure you have the correct Minecraft version (`1.21.11`).
* Load up Minecraft

## Dependencies
* Fabric API – Required for mod functionality.
* Fabric Language Kotlin – Required for Kotlin support in Fabric mods.

## Contributing

## Planned
* Bring back old hit sounds.
* Remove the dependency for Fabric Language Kotlin. The mod is small enough that kotlin isn't really needed.
* Item Transformations

## FAQ
* Q: Does this restore 1.7 item transformations? A: NO!
